title: ambrina ambrosioides
intro: Ambrina ambrosioides, commonly known as the "Indian valerian," is a plant species that belongs to the family Apiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as an antispasmodic and anxiolytic agent, helping to reduce anxiety and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Ambrina ambrosioides include its sedative properties, which can aid in the treatment of insomnia and restlessness. The bioactive constituents of this plant include valerenic acid and isovaleric acid, among others, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
